doctoral_direction: Resilience-Aware Service Continuity in Heterogeneous 6G Networks: Cross-Layer Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Devices
truth_boundary: 5G-Advanced / NTN-capable research architecture, IMT-2030 aligned, software-defined, engineered for migration toward standardized 6G — not a final standardized/commercial 6G product.

RQ1.canonical_rq_v3: How can representative workloads and the constraints of four resource-constrained device classes be translated into measurable service-continuity profiles, metrics, and benchmark scenarios?
RQ1.gap: Joint communication/compute/fidelity/recovery representation is not a single frozen action model; RQ1 statistical pack is lighter than Paper II CIs.

RQ2.canonical_rq_v3: To what extent can joint access selection, computation placement, fidelity/model adaptation, caching/checkpointing, and recovery control - informed by radio-aware digital-twin state and uncertainty - improve service-continuity utility under mobility, blockage, congestion, edge-resource variation, and energy constraints?
RQ2.strongest_evidence: spectrumx Paper II held-out/ablation/domain-shift JSON with 95% t-CI; ReadyGary FR2 beam held-out JSON. Both SYNTHETIC_SIM.
RQ2.gap: Shipped Action is network x placement x shares/power (plus beam/band). Fidelity adaptation and checkpoint/recover are MISSING_DIGITAL. Not trained RL.

RQ3.canonical_rq_v3: Under which disruption conditions do terrestrial, local-edge, peer/device-to-device, offline, and NTN fallback modes preserve minimum useful service, and what performance, energy, privacy, and recovery tradeoffs arise in simulation, emulation, and device-level measurements?
RQ3.evidence_audit_interpretation: TN/NTN disruption, fallback, and transfer toward measurement
RQ3.strongest_evidence: ntn-resilience-sim paper/artifacts/rq3_experiment_summary.json + reproduce JSON; rejects NTN-always-better under configured assumptions.
RQ3.gap: No sim→measurement transfer. Edge I/O spatial/RF PHYSICAL_PENDING. Independent reproduction EXTERNAL_PENDING. Human QA HUMAN_PENDING.
